# TC-CLI-204 backup --encrypt aes256 未配套 --password-stdin → 退出码 2 + E_USAGE

exec expect 2 --json backup --source /x --encrypt aes256
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_USAGE"'

# --encrypt 取值非法同样 E_USAGE
exec expect 2 --json backup --source /x --encrypt rot13
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_USAGE"'
